## Scope
- [ ] Customer Portal only
- [ ] POS/IT repositories unchanged unless explicitly documented

## Validation
- [ ] npm run typecheck
- [ ] npm run test
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile checked when UI changed

## Security / data integrity
- [ ] No privileged key exposed to browser code
- [ ] Tenant + branch authorization remains server-side
- [ ] Billing / sales / stock mutations preserve audited flows
